notes: 🤖 The robot now says what it's doing on the MAIN screen, not just inside its panel. We audited every step of auto-buy after a report that it was slow and found no faults — the two honest reasons it can look idle: after a data load it deliberately waits until ~60% of shares have signals prepared (minutes on a phone), and it acts once per data day, so once it has run it sits quietly until the next close. A small always-visible line under the data box now shows exactly that: “bot: today's signals are still preparing (1,204 of ~1,329 shares ready)”, “bot: done for 2026-08-18 — runs again when new data loads (nothing to press)”. Same truth the robot panel always told — now where your eyes are.
